title: MemeMind: A Large-Scale Multimodal Dataset with Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Harmful Meme Detection
reasoning: The paper focuses on the detection of harmful memes across several categories such as discrimination, violence, and vulgarity. While it includes religion as a protected identity group within its discrimination taxonomy, the research is fundamentally a safety and toxicity benchmarking study rather than an evaluation or theological/ethical analysis of religion, spiritual traditions, or moral philosophy.
